title: The gate
hints: Your wizard needs an instruction to take one step.
Look at your notebook to see the move actions.
Use the `move_right` method on your wizard, followed by empty brackets.
intro: Here we are, right in front of the great gate! We need to step up to it to see if it opens. Let us write a program to walk one step to the right.
outro: Great! You have learned to move your wizard. The gate stays shut for now, but that is fine: first we master the basics, and then we will figure out how to get through.
learned: Now you know what a program and an instruction are, and the instruction that moves your wizard.
